As a counselling psychologist, I provide a secure and confidential setting where clients can openly express their concerns and emotions. With an atmosphere of acceptance and understanding, I offer individualized support and guidance, employing evidence-based psychological approaches such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and the principles of Positive Psychology.
My primary objective is to empower clients by helping them identify effective tools and strategies to address their challenges, fostering resilience and personal growth.
I specialize in supporting couples experiencing relationship challenges, helping them cultivate a more fulfilling and connected partnership.

For adults with ADHD, as well as parents of children with ADHD, I offer a tailored psychoeducational approach aimed at addressing and overcoming daily challenges. Throughout the year, I also facilitate experiential psychoeducational workshops designed specifically for parents and adults with ADHD.

Additionally, I provide counselling for individuals struggling with addictions, such as substance abuse or behavioral dependencies, empowering them to make healthier choices and take meaningful steps toward a more balanced life.
